_comment: Flora grafts placed from the shell parts' graft anchors (Config/ShellAnchors/*.json, names in Art/Shells/tools/anchor_spec.py), so they fit whatever head, core, arms and legs a robot wears (Characters/WWOBodyAnchors.cpp). Used instead of the fitted model grafts where a model has anchor_grafts on (Config/CharacterModels.json) or with wwo.AnchorGrafts 1 / -WWOAnchorGrafts, and only for a flora listed here; edit and restart, no build. floras.<flora id>: a list of placements per thing equipped: 'grenade' (any grenade) and each ability id. A placement puts one piece on an anchor ('anchor': its name) or one every spacing_cm along a path ('path': its name; 'range': [from, to] fractions of its length, default [0, 1]). '{s}' in a name means both sides: once with l, once with r (the r one's across offset is mirrored). Each piece is laid in the anchor's frame: out of the surface (n), across (up x n; on a front-facing anchor that is the robot's right), and its up (Head and Core: toward the robot's up; Arms and Legs: along the limb toward the body; along a path: the path's direction). offset: [out, across, up] cm from the anchor; keep it small: an anchor measures the part's surface only at its own point, and a few cm away another shell's surface can stand several cm further out or in (the scout core's codpiece buried pods placed 9 cm above hip_front, or 4 to 8 cm to its side); stay within the anchor's size. along: which way a plate's length runs: 'down' (against up: down the body, down a limb toward the hand or foot; the default), 'up', or 'across'. scale_by_size: the piece grows or shrinks with the anchor's size (its size / size_ref, default 5 cm, kept within 0.6 to 1.6), so a bigger part's flat spot gets a bigger piece. Pieces (FWWOGraftBuilder, all sizes cm): 'plate', a bark slab with glowing cracks: length, width, curve (the radius it bends round, small to wrap a limb; default 30), thickness (default 2), lift (its far end, toward along, raised off the body, default 0), cracked (default true); 'seed_pod', an amber pod hanging straight down from the point on a stalk: length, width, stalk (default 10, 3.5, 4).
